title: Dumbbell 8wk Program
author: Steve-o
desc: A 8 week program built to just need my bench and a few dumbbells so there are no excuses to not exercise.

ss.note: Blades pinned down+back, elbows ~45 deg from torso (not flared to 90), lower to mid-chest. · Weights: 10 / 10 / 12 kg
Hinge ~45 deg, brace free hand on bench. Pull the bell to your HIP, lead with the elbow, let the shoulder blade move. This is your heavy pull — drive the weight up over the weeks.
Bell at chest, elbows down, sit BETWEEN the hips, knees track over toes, chest tall, controlled depth. · Weights: 10 / 10 / 12 kg
Rear foot on the bench, most weight through the FRONT heel, torso tall, knee tracks over the foot. Sit straight down.
Weight in one hand, soft knee, hips push BACK, spine long. Go for a hamstring stretch, not depth. Balance is part of the lift — slow it down.
Weights: 10 / 10 / 12 kg
